sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Flow Mania are simple yet addictive. Your goal is to connect pairs of colorful dots with a pipe to create a flow between them. This might seem easy, but as you progress through levels, the game throws in a challenge to cover the entire board with pipe, without allowing any pipes to cross or overlap each other. This delicate balance of creativity and precision is what makes Flow Mania so engaging.

One of the key aspects of Flow Mania's gameplay is the way the game rewards creativity and problem-solving. As you play, you'll need to think creatively about how to connect the dots and create a flow of pipe that covers the entire board. This will often involve using multiple pipes in a single level, which can be a fun and challenging puzzle to solve.

The game also features a variety of obstacles and challenges that will test your skills and push you to think creatively. For example, some levels may feature obstacles that block the path of your flow, or special dots that can be used to create new pipes. These challenges will require you to think on your feet and adapt your strategy to overcome them.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Flow Mania are simple yet engaging, making it a great game for anyone looking for a fun and challenging puzzle experience.
